page.layout: One column of running text; in the right margin, beside the last lines, a small Hebrew note.

main_text.p: accepistis, cuius magis auspicio staretur? Item respondit Valerius, Cõsulis. Iam me herculè, inquit, cum de imperio & auspicio inter vos disceptationem susceperim, & tu utroque aduersarium tuum superiorem fuisse fatearis, nihil est quod ulterius dubitem. Itaque Luctati quamuis adhuc tacueris, secundum te litem do. Controversia igitur ex Ductus verbo nata est. Sponsio est enim, Ni ductu suo, etcet. Intentio, Ductu meo Punica classis deuicta est. Ego enim solus, te claudo in lectica iacête, Imperatoris officio [illegible, ~6 letters] sum

page.notes: Right margin: a short Hebrew note beside "officio", too faint to read; left as illegible. The line "fum" at the foot is printed "sum" (long s rendered as plain s). "deuiêta" read as "deuicta" with doubt; the final letter is uncertain. "iacête" kept as printed; the tilde may mark an omitted n or m.
